description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402] The transaction count of an address at one stated block. Pending-pool transactions are not counted, and the answer says so.

address.description: 0x + 40 hex digits (EIP-55 checksum enforced when mixed-case)

block.description: "latest" (default), "safe", "finalized", or a decimal block number. Every value in the answer is read at this one block

chain.description: EVM CAIP-2 chain id such as eip155:8453, or a bare chain id number as a string. Chain names are refused.

name: evm_nonce
title: EVM account nonce
